quantifier: Every finite integer N>=1, every K>=4*N+12, every independent fixed point of the 15*N physical parameter box, and all wire-error sequences within the stated budgets
scope: Directed chain with supplied preparation and input protocol; not arbitrary graphs, cycles, fixed 25-pulse scalability or unlimited per-hop jitter
physical_family: All C,Lm,Ls,Le,M parameters independently in the nominal relative box for each port of each cell; other R constants unchanged

protocol.preparation: Routes closed. Each relay: 16 direct port-2 pulses at 0,8,...,120. Leaf: same train on port 1. Wait until 160.
protocol.fast: K direct leaf port-0 pulses at 160+4*k, k=0,...,K-1. Each downstream emission drives its parent port 2. No other fast source.
protocol.routes: A finite directed leaf-to-root chain, enabled from 160, with no reverse edge or feedback cycle
protocol.wire: One canonical pulse per emission, without loss or waveform deformation. delay_i,k = d_i + error_i,k; sigma_i in [0,0.05], d_i fixed in [0.3+sigma_i,0.4-sigma_i], abs(error_i,k)<=sigma_i
protocol.jitter_sum: sum(sigma_i)<=0.15; fixed-link case sigma_i=0 supports any finite depth without tightening the physical boxes

packet_contract.name: P(m,L,J)
packet_contract.prefix: m>=1 ideal dates with consecutive gaps in [7.4,8.3]
packet_contract.tail: L>=1 ideal dates starting d in [4,4.1] after the final prefix date, then period 4
packet_contract.actual: Each actual date equals its ideal date plus an arbitrary phase error in [-J,J]; an existential template, no independent-noise assumption
packet_contract.local_assumption: Prepared relay at exact main rest, gain = own birth active gain * exp(1.8), b = birth b + 0.1, auxiliaries READY, no currents, E in [50,100]; J<=0.15, L>=5
packet_contract.local_guarantee: P(m,L,J) -> P(m+2,L-4,J); exactly two full MARK doses and one full ERROR dose; no raw-tail refiring
packet_contract.leaf_base: K>=9 exact period-4 source -> P(3,K-8,0), with two full MARK doses and four full ERROR doses on its active port

composition.node_index: j=0 at leaf, j=N-1 at root
composition.scaling: Source length and time horizon are linear in N; total fast-block traffic is quadratic at the minimum K

conclusion.recovery: b_after = b_birth+0.3 = b_before_fast+0.2 in every cell
conclusion.active_gain: Own birth active gain * exp(2.4) on leaf port 0 and every relay port 2
conclusion.retained_probe: Eight canonical period-4 pulses on disconnected standardized-rest copies with learning disabled: leaf 0/8 -> 8/8, every relay 4/8 -> 8/8
conclusion.cut: Cut any link during the fast phase: every ancestor above that cut remains at its prepared settings and its retained probe stays 4/8
conclusion.end: All cells READY with main q exactly 0.1 and no active currents; no cell is removed

arithmetic: N-independent local inequalities: outward Decimal generation and separate integer replay. Polynomial identities checked exactly. Universal composition uses the written packet induction, not finite-N enumeration or full Lean formalization

independent_check.scope: Pulses-only prefix from the declared birth family through 459.9, not settings copies or later reciprocal/adaptive phases
